name: claude-rental-team
description: Claude agents, skills, commands and templates to run a real estate company in Brazil, the US and Europe: buying, appraisal, sales, renovation and property management.

plugins.name: rt-executive
plugins.description: Company direction, KPIs, approval authority and cross-department routing.

plugins.name: rt-acquisitions
plugins.description: Property sourcing, opportunity screening, feasibility and purchase negotiation.

plugins.name: rt-appraisal
plugins.description: Market, income and cost valuation, and technical property inspection.

plugins.name: rt-legal
plugins.description: Title due diligence, contracts, tenancy law, disputes, privacy and anti-money-laundering.

plugins.name: rt-renovation
plugins.description: Scope, budget, schedule and quality control of renovation works.

plugins.name: rt-marketing
plugins.description: Campaigns, listings, content, paid media and lead generation.

plugins.name: rt-pre-sales
plugins.description: Lead qualification, visit scheduling and follow-up before the sales stage.

plugins.name: rt-sales
plugins.description: Proposals, negotiation, financing, closing and commissions.

plugins.name: rt-crm
plugins.description: Pipeline, segmentation, data quality and automated customer journeys.

plugins.name: rt-property-management
plugins.description: Leasing, tenants, inspections, maintenance and condominium administration.

plugins.name: rt-post-sales
plugins.description: Handover, warranty, complaints and customer retention.

plugins.name: rt-finance
plugins.description: Payables, receivables, collections, cash, owner payouts, close and taxes.

plugins.name: rt-technology-data
plugins.description: Systems integration, business intelligence and information security.

plugins.name: rt-jurisdictions
plugins.description: Brazil, United States and Europe rules used by all departments.
